1397:             MSI: begin
1398: 
1399:                 // The bounded N bank has no MRIF handler. Reject through the
1400:                 // original fault/error path, never as a normal payload success.
1401:                 // S/P and all global MSI capabilities keep the original logic.
1402:                 if (restricted_msi) begin
1403:                     error_code_n = rv_iommu::TRANS_TYPE_DISALLOWED;
1404:                     error_n = 1'b1;
1405:                     is_mrif_n = 1'b0;
1406:                     ignore_n = 1'b0;
1407:                     state_n = dc_q.tc.dtf ? COMPLETE : ERROR;
1408:                 end
1409:                 // MSI Translation supported
1410:                 else if (RVIOMMUCfg.MSITrans != rv_iommu_cfg::MSI_DISABLED) begin
1411: 
1412:                     // default
1413:                     error_code_n    = rv_iommu::TRANS_TYPE_DISALLOWED;
1414:                     spaddr_n        = {iotlb_lu_content.content_2S.ppn[PPNW-1:0],
1415:                                         req_data.iova[11:0]};
1416:                     mrif_n          = mrifc_lu_content;
1417: 
1418:                     /*
1419:                       An MSI Page Table Walk may end in:
1420:                         (1) Error;
1421:                         (2) Ignored transaction;
1422:                         (3) IOTLB update and hit;
1423:                         (4) MRIFC update and hit
1424:                     */
1425: 
1426:                     // (1) MSI PTW error
1427:                     if (msi_ptw_error) begin
1428:                         error_code_n = msi_ptw_cause;
1429:                         state_n = (dc_q.tc.dtf) ? (COMPLETE) : (ERROR);
1430:                     end
1431: 
1432:                     // (2) Ignore transaction
1433:                     if (msi_ptw_ignore) begin
1434:                         ignore_n    = 1'b1;
1435:                         state_n     = COMPLETE;
1436:                     end
1437: 
1438:                     // (3) MSI PTE in BT mode
1439:                     if (iotlb_lu_hit) begin
1440:                         state_n     = COMPLETE;
1441:                     end
1442: 
1443:                     // (4) MSI PTE in MRIF mode
1444:                     if (mrifc_lu_hit) begin
1445:                         state_n     = COMPLETE;
1446:                         is_mrif_n   = 1'b1;
1447:                         if (req_data.is_debug) begin
1448:                             state_n = ERROR;
1449:                         end
1450:                     end
1451:                 end
1452: 
1453:                 // MSI Translation not supported
1454:                 else begin
1455:                     state_n         = ERROR;
1456:                     error_code_n    = rv_iommu::TRANS_TYPE_DISALLOWED;
1457:                 end
1458:             end
1459: 
1460:             ERROR: begin
1461:                 if(req_data.ttype == rv_iommu::PCIE_ATS_TRANS_REQ) begin
1462:                     if( error_code_q != INSTR_PAGE_FAULT       &&
1463:                         error_code_q != LOAD_PAGE_FAULT        &&
1464:                         error_code_q != STORE_PAGE_FAULT       &&
1465:                         error_code_q != INSTR_GUEST_PAGE_FAULT &&
1466:                         error_code_q != LOAD_GUEST_PAGE_FAULT  &&
1467:                         error_code_q != STORE_GUEST_PAGE_FAULT &&
1468:                         error_code_q != MSI_PTE_INVALID        &&
1469:                         error_code_q != PDT_ENTRY_INVALID) begin
1470: 
1471:                         error_n = 1'b1;
1472:                         state_n = COMPLETE;
1473:                     end else begin
1474:                         error_n = 1'b1;
1475:                         fault_valid_o = 1'b1;
1476:                         if (fault_ready_i) begin
1477:                             state_n = COMPLETE;
1478:                         end
1479:                     end
1480:                 end else begin
1481:                     error_n = 1'b1;
1482:                     fault_valid_o = 1'b1;
1483:                     if (fault_ready_i) begin
1484:                         state_n = COMPLETE;
1485:                     end
1486:                 end
1487:             end
1488: 
1489:             // Translation completion
1490:             COMPLETE: begin
1491: 
1492:                 // Debug translation
1493:                 if (req_data.is_debug) begin
1494:                     debug_resp_valid_o  = 1'b1;
1495:                     if (debug_resp_ready_i) begin
1496:                         state_n = IDLE;
1497:                     end
1498:                 end
1499:                 // ATS transltion
1500:                 else if(req_data.ttype == rv_iommu::PCIE_ATS_TRANS_REQ) begin
1501:                     ats_trans_resp_valid_o  = 1'b1;
1502:                     if (ats_trans_resp_ready_i) begin
1503:                         state_n = IDLE;
1504:                     end
1505:                 end
1506:                 // Normal translation
1507:                 else begin

76:     // MSI-BT FSM States
